input.quote: 19.2 For fifteen days after delivery, each Deliverable will materially conform to its documentation; after that date Vendor has no correction or refund obligation.
input.rationale: Sections 19.1, 19.3 and 19.5 are strong: professional-and-workmanlike services, material conformity to documentation, no malicious code, compliance with Applicable Law, and a disclaimer that expressly does not limit express warranties. Section 19.4 supplies the preferred remedy (re-perform/repair/replace, then terminate and refund Fees paid). The failing term is duration: Section 19.2 limits the Deliverable conformity warranty to fifteen days after delivery and then states that Vendor has "no correction or refund obligation," which both falls short of the 30/90-day fallback and cuts off the otherwise open-ended Section 19.1 warranty and the Section 19.4 remedy for Deliverables. Note also that the fifteen-day window effectively expires with the fifteen-business-day acceptance period in Section 6.1, leaving no post-acceptance warranty at all. Minimal fix: extend to ninety days and confirm Section 19.2 does not limit Sections 19.1 or 19.4.

proposal.summary: Extend Deliverable conformity warranty from fifteen to ninety days and stop it cutting off the Section 19.1 warranty and 19.4 remedies
proposal.comment: [Playbook] We have extended the Deliverable conformity warranty from fifteen to ninety days, which is our standard minimum period for deliverables, and confirmed that this section does not cut off the general warranty in Section 19.1 or the re-perform/refund remedy in Section 19.4. As drafted, the fifteen-day cut-off of any correction or refund obligation leaves us without a meaningful remedy for defects that surface shortly after delivery.

ops.oldText: For fifteen days after delivery, each Deliverable will materially conform to its documentation; after that date Vendor has no correction or refund obligation.
ops.newText: For ninety days after delivery, each Deliverable will materially conform to its documentation. This Section does not limit the warranties in Section 19.1 or the remedies in Section 19.4.
